now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
now.text: Coulson stops Jiaying's plan to spread Terrigen across the world, losing his hand in the process.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The director Jiaying pretends to make peace with, then wars on.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Skye's mother, who fakes peace, then wars on S.H.I.E.L.D. and costs Coulson a hand.

proposed.text: Coulson leads the strike on the Iliad to stop Jiaying's Terrigen plan and loses his hand when he catches one of her crystals.

changes.evidence: S2#22 (S.O.S. Part Two): Coulson, Mack and Fitz stop Gordon in the Iliad's vent room; Coulson catches the falling crystal and Mack cuts off his hand. It is Skye who blasts Jiaying's Quinjet of crystals meant for the world into the ocean, so Coulson does not stop the worldwide plan.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
now.text: Kara Palamas works at Sunil Bakshi's side as a Hydra assassin after his team kidnaps and brainwashes her. Together they capture Melinda May, and Kara takes May's face to fool her team.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Kara's Hydra superior, whose team brainwashed her into an assassin.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The brainwashed assassin at Bakshi's side, who takes May's face.

proposed.text: Kara Palamas works at Sunil Bakshi's side as a brainwashed Hydra assassin. Together they capture Melinda May, and Kara takes May's face to fool her team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Kara's Hydra superior, at whose side she works as an assassin.

changes.evidence: Whitehall, not Bakshi, brainwashes Agent 33 (S2#3, shown on screen). That Bakshi's team kidnapped her is only revealed in S2#14 (Love in the Time of Hydra), so it is a later fact at S2#4.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9
now.text: Lance Hunter mocks Raina when she comes begging S.H.I.E.L.D. for protection, but he still helps guard her from Hydra in Vancouver. Earlier, his attempt to kill Carl Creel creates the chaos Raina uses to slip away with the Diviner.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A seer Hunter mocks but helps guard from Hydra.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who mocks Raina but helps guard her in Vancouver.

proposed.text: Lance Hunter helps guard Raina from Hydra in Vancouver, and when she tries to surrender to Hydra, he and May drive her clear. Earlier, his attempt to kill Carl Creel creates the chaos Raina uses to slip away with the Diviner.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A woman Hunter helps guard from Hydra in Vancouver.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps guard Raina from Hydra in Vancouver.

changes.evidence: S2#9 (...Ye Who Enter Here): Raina does not come begging S.H.I.E.L.D.; Sam Koenig hides her from Agent 33, and when she tries to surrender to Hydra, Hunter and May drive the SUV into the Hydra agents and escape with her. Calling her a seer at S2#9 is a later fact: her visions only start after her change (S2#17).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
now.text: May and Coulson hand their prisoner Bakshi over to the real Glenn Talbot.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra prisoner May and Coulson hand over to Talbot.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who hands Bakshi over to Talbot.

proposed.text: May and Coulson stage a fake ambush on Bakshi's transport, letting themselves be shot so he escapes and leads S.H.I.E.L.D. to Hydra's other leaders.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra prisoner May helps trick into leading S.H.I.E.L.D. to Hydra's leaders.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who stages a fake ambush to trick Bakshi.

changes.evidence: S2#11 (Aftershocks): Coulson and May ride with Bakshi, are seemingly shot in a staged attack, and Bakshi has the Hydra cell leaders killed. Morse and Hunter then take him away to be handed to Talbot; May and Coulson do not hand him over.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
now.text: During the Hydra Uprising, Mack keeps Gonzales calm while the agents treat his wounded leg aboard the Iliad, then talks him into retaking the ship from Hydra.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's boss, whom Mack talks into retaking the Iliad.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Gonzales' agent, who keeps him calm on the Iliad.

proposed.text: During the Hydra Uprising, Mack keeps Gonzales calm while his wounded leg is treated aboard the Iliad, then talks Bobbi out of destroying the ship, and they fight to retake it from Hydra.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's boss, whom Mack helps retake the Iliad from Hydra.

changes.evidence: S2#15 (One Door Closes) flashback: Gonzales reminds Bobbi of Fury's order to destroy the Iliad; it is Bobbi whom Mack talks into retaking the ship instead.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
now.text: Phil Coulson captures Werner von Strucker and interrogates him to find Gideon Malick, driven by revenge for Rosalind Price's murder. Broken by his ordeal, Werner begs Coulson to just kill him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra's heir, whom Coulson interrogates for Malick to avenge Rosalind.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The man who interrogates Werner until he begs to die.

proposed.text: Phil Coulson has the comatose Werner von Strucker revived and interrogates him to find Gideon Malick, driven by revenge for Rosalind Price's murder. Reliving his torture, Werner begs Coulson to just kill him.

changes.evidence: S3#11 (Bouncing Back): Werner has been in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s care in a coma since Lisbon (S3#6); Coulson uses the memory machine on him and he begs to be killed. Coulson does not capture him.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18
now.text: Hive gives James Terrigen, and as Hellfire he serves Hive alongside the Daisy that Hive controls.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A new Inhuman who serves Hive beside Daisy.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman under Hive's control, serving beside Hellfire.

proposed.text: Under Hive's control, Daisy shatters a Terrigen crystal in James's home, and as Hellfire he serves Hive alongside her.

changes.evidence: S3#18 (The Singularity): Daisy smashes the Terrigen Crystal that sets off James's Terrigenesis while Hive watches; Hive then binds him. Hive does not give him the Terrigen.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#5
now.text: Out of prison, Ramon tries to sell an 0-8-4 weapon to the Watchdogs. Daisy tracks the deal to help Yo-Yo, who wants revenge for her cousin, and blasts Ramon aside before he is killed in the fight.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The colonel Daisy fights again when he sells a weapon to the Watchdogs.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts Ramon aside to help Yo-Yo.

proposed.text: Out of prison, Ramon tries to sell an 0-8-4 weapon to the Watchdogs. Daisy, who comes after the weapon, finds Yo-Yo held there and blasts Ramon aside to free her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts Ramon aside to free Yo-Yo.

changes.evidence: Slingshot#5 (Deal Breaker): Daisy had come for the weapon and rescues the captive Yo-Yo, sending Ramon flying with a shockwave. Ramon dies in Slingshot#6 (Justicia), hit by the weapon Briggs fires, so his death is not in #5.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
now.text: Elena Rodriguez and Daisy Johnson are friends and fellow Inhumans. Daisy recruits Elena for the Secret Warriors.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's friend and a fellow Inhuman, recruited for the Secret Warriors.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Elena's friend and a fellow Inhuman. Recruits Elena for the Secret Warriors.

proposed.text: Daisy Johnson helps catch Elena Rodriguez in Bogotá, then fights beside her to rescue Bobbi and Hunter, and Elena agrees to join Daisy's Secret Warriors.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman who joins Daisy's Secret Warriors.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Inhuman whose Secret Warriors Elena joins.

changes.evidence: S3#11 (Bouncing Back): Daisy arrives to help capture Elena; Mack talks her into helping rescue Bobbi and Hunter and Joey urges her to join the Secret Warriors. Daisy does not recruit her, and they have only just met.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#16
now.text: In 1970, on the day of their father's funeral, Daniel Whitehall recruits Gideon Malick and his brother Nathaniel into active roles in HYDRA. He hints to Gideon how to rig the ritual of stones that sends one member to Hive's planet.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A young HYDRA heir Whitehall recruits in 1970 and tips off about rigging Hive's ritual.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA leader who recruits Malick in 1970 and hints how to rig Hive's ritual.

proposed.text: In 1970, just after their father's death, Daniel Whitehall summons Gideon Malick and his brother Nathaniel to his cell and urges them to follow his path in HYDRA. Gideon refuses, but Whitehall hints how their father rigged the ritual of stones that sends one member to Hive's planet.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A young HYDRA heir Whitehall summons in 1970 and tips off about rigging Hive's ritual.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA leader who summons Malick in 1970 and hints how to rig Hive's ritual.

changes.evidence: S3#16 (Paradise Lost): Whitehall calls the brothers to the Rat and suggests they follow his path; Gideon calls him a coward and walks out, though Whitehall points them to their father's copy of Paradise Lost and his trick. He does not recruit them into active roles.
